title: The jailer's file: submariners on LSD
place_text: a US military base (file found by McKinnon)

tellings.quote: on one site I found the jailer's file. Every military base has a jailer. M. And it's just crazy. You've got guys taking LSD that work on submarines.

plain: A computer hacker named Gary McKinnon says that, while breaking into US military computers around 2000 to 2002, he found the jailer's file on one base, the record kept by the officer who runs its jail. In it, he says, were men who worked on submarines taking LSD, a powerful hallucinogenic drug. McKinnon tells Michels this from his own hacking as one of the stranger things he stumbled on.
